Project root: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS (Stack A: Next.js 16 + Supabase). Execution plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/deep-check-page-and-twinkling-moon.md (Phase 0 section). Do NOT skim — read the plan first, then execute.

Existing Flash Events migration to extend: supabase/migrations/20260422100000_flash_events.sql (already provides flash_events / flash_event_designs / flash_event_slots tables + RPCs `generate_flash_event_slots`, `public_reserve_flash_slot`, `confirm_flash_slot_booking`).

Write a NEW migration file at supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql doing exactly:

1. ALTER `flash_event_slots`:
   - ADD COLUMN `no_show_marked_at timestamptz NULL`
   - ADD COLUMN `grace_expires_at timestamptz NULL`
   - ADD COLUMN `checked_in_at timestamptz NULL`
   - ADD COLUMN `walk_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - DROP existing status CHECK + ADD new: `CHECK (status IN ('open','reserved','booked','blocked','no_show'))`
   - ADD CHECK constraint named `chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking`: `(status <> 'booked' OR booking_id IS NOT NULL)`. Backfill first: any existing `booked` slot with NULL booking_id → set status='open' so the constraint passes on add.

2. ALTER `flash_events`:
   - ADD COLUMN `completed_at timestamptz NULL`
   - ADD COLUMN `tips_collected_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`

3. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_walkin(p_slot_id uuid, p_client_info jsonb, p_charge_at_desk boolean) returns jsonb` — SECURITY DEFINER. Logic: validate slot exists + status='open', upsert client by email scoped to studio (mirror upsert from existing `public_reserve_flash_slot`), create bookings row with source='walk-in', set walk_in=true on slot, transition slot directly to 'booked' (skip reserved), atomic via FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Returns `{ booking_id, booking_token, slot_id, error? }`.

4. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates slot is currently 'booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL. Sets status='no_show', no_show_marked_at=now(). Updates linked booking row: status='no_show'. Returns true if transition occurred.

5. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates slot is currently 'booked'. Sets checked_in_at=now(). Returns true.

6. New RPC `duplicate_flash_event(p_event_id uuid) returns uuid` — SECURITY DEFINER. Inserts a new flash_events row copying all columns EXCEPT: id (new uuid), slug (append `-copy-` + extract(epoch from now())::int), status='draft', published_at=NULL, cancelled_at=NULL, completed_at=NULL, event_date=CURRENT_DATE + 14. Deep-copy all flash_event_designs rows with FK pointing to new event id. Do NOT copy slots. Return new event id.

7. New RPC `close_flash_event(p_event_id uuid) returns jsonb` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates event status='published'. Sets status='completed', completed_at=now(). Returns summary jsonb: `{ event_id, completed_count, no_show_count, slot_revenue_cents, deposits_collected_cents, tips_cents, top_design: { id, title, count } | null, artist_id }`.

8. UPDATE existing `confirm_flash_slot_booking(p_booking_id uuid)` RPC to ALSO set `grace_expires_at = slot_start + interval '15 minutes'` when transitioning to booked. Use CREATE OR REPLACE.

9. ADD INDEX `idx_flash_event_slots_grace ON flash_event_slots(grace_expires_at) WHERE status='booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL`.

10. Backfill (BEFORE adding chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking): `UPDATE flash_event_slots SET status='open' WHERE status='booked' AND booking_id IS NULL;`

11. Inline studio-membership check inside SECURITY DEFINER staff-facing RPCs (no_show, checked_in, duplicate, close) — RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' if auth.uid() not a studio member. `mark_flash_slot_walkin` skips this (called from server action with service-role client which has no auth.uid).

12. Full ROLLBACK comments at the top.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Idempotent: use `DO $$ BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL; END $$;` for ADD COLUMN.
- For CHECK constraint replacement: try `ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS flash_event_slots_status_check;` then re-add named.
- Comment heavily.
- After writing, attempt `pnpm db:migrate` if local Supabase is running, else skip and note. Then `pnpm db:types`.

Report: file path, RPCs added, db:migrate/db:types status. Under 300 words.

1	# Flash Events Page — Deep Audit Implementation
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). Mission: take the page from "demos as broken" to **"Saturday-morning mission control"** — publish a sheet on Wednesday, fill it by Friday, run the day on Saturday, close the books before dinner.
6	
7	The audit gives a definitive verdict per element: **5 cuts · 1 move · 5 fixes · 11 adds**. This plan ports every verdict into surgical code changes against the existing implementation, reusing existing primitives wherever possible (PageShell, PageHeader, FlashEventDetailShell, formatCurrency, qrcode pkg, Resend/Twilio queue jobs, `enqueueSendDepositLink`).
8	
9	Stack A · Next.js 16 · Supabase · feature-key `flash_events` (Studio+) · brand: Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## The Long Prompt (master spec — the single source of truth for execution)
14	
15	This is the contract. Every cut/fix/add lives here. Implementation phases below decompose it.
16	
17	### A. INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE
18	
19	**A1.** Status filter on `/flash-events` reduces from 6 → 4 chips: `Upcoming · Drafts · Completed · All`. Drop `Published`, drop `Cancelled`. Cancelled events surface inside `All` with a destructive status badge — they don't deserve top-level real estate.
20	
21	**A2.** Detail page tab strip reduces from 5 → 3: `Overview · Designs · Slots`. Drop `Bookings` (fold into Slots — a booking IS a slot with a client). Drop `Settings` (the Edit button at the top opens the same editor — two paths to one place).
22	
23	**A3.** Detail page header actions reorder: `[Edit] [Publish if draft] [View public page] [⋯ overflow]`. The destructive `Cancel event` moves into the `⋯` overflow dropdown menu with red text + AlertDialog confirm. No destructive button at primary visual weight.
24	
25	### B. P0 SHIP BLOCKERS — must fix before anything else
26	
27	**B1. Slots tab Client column** — Demo data shows "—" for booked rows. Root cause: `flash_event_slots.booking_id` not linked to a `bookings` row in seed, so `slot.booking?.client` is null. The render code at [components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx:91-100](components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx#L91-L100) is correct; the data link is broken. Fix in seed module + add Realtime constraint that any slot with `status='booked'` MUST have non-null `booking_id` (CHECK constraint).
28	
29	**B2. Slots tab Deposit column** — Same root cause as B1. Once B1 fix lands, [components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx:103-113](components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx#L103-L113) will render `Paid · $100 / Pending` correctly.
30	
31	**B3. Edit form artist/location dropdowns** — code at [components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx:132-145](components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx#L132-L145) renders `display_name` correctly; the PDF "shows raw UUID" claim may stem from `defaultValue={event.artist_id ?? '__none__'}` showing the value when artist list hasn't loaded. Add SSR pre-loaded artist list verification + `<SelectValue placeholder>` polish + handle case where `event.artist_id` doesn't match any loaded artist (orphaned reference). Show name not UUID always.
32	
33	**B4. Cents-based pricing input** — [components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx:218-237](components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx#L218-L237) labels read "Slot Price (cents)" with raw cent values. Replace with a `<MoneyInput>` component that shows dollars (`$250.00`), accepts decimal input, and converts to cents on submit via hidden field. New form action `name="slotPriceCents"` still receives cents.
34	
35	**B5. Server-action `__none__` sentinel** — [app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts:111-114](app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts#L111-L114) accepts `locationId` / `artistId` strings raw. If form submits `'__none__'`, it gets passed to the schema. Sanitize: `formData.get('artistId') === '__none__' ? null : formData.get('artistId')`.
36	
37	### C. CUTS
38	
39	**C1.** Remove `Published` filter chip from [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:14-21](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L14-L21).
40	**C2.** Remove `Cancelled` filter chip (same file).
41	**C3.** Remove `bookings` tab from `TABS` in [components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx:48-54](components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx#L48-L54).
42	**C4.** Remove `settings` tab (same file).
43	**C5.** Delete file [components/flash-events/FlashEventBookingsTab.tsx](components/flash-events/FlashEventBookingsTab.tsx) entirely (data moves into Slots).
44	**C6.** Delete `SettingsTab` component inside FlashEventDetailShell.
45	**C7.** Update `VALID_STATUS_FILTERS` in [app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx:23](app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx#L23) to drop `published` + `cancelled` (add fallback redirect logic so old links don't 404; default to `upcoming`).
46	
47	### D. MOVES
48	
49	**D1.** `Cancel event` button → DropdownMenu overflow. New component pattern at top of `FlashEventDetailShell.tsx`:
50	```tsx
51	<DropdownMenu>
52	  <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" />}>
53	    <MoreHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
54	  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
55	  <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
56	    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setDuplicateOpen(true)}>Duplicate event</DropdownMenuItem>
57	    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setCloseOpen(true)} disabled={status !== 'published'}>Close event</DropdownMenuItem>
58	    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
59	    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setCancelOpen(true)} className="text-destructive">Cancel event</DropdownMenuItem>
60	  </DropdownMenuContent>
61	</DropdownMenu>
62	```
63	
64	### E. FIXES
65	
66	**E1.** Cover image upload — extend Edit form to support cover image upload to `flash-event-assets` bucket. Empty card thumbnail at [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:103-107](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L103-L107) currently shows fallback Zap icon. After fix, fallback uses `event.artist.avatar_url` if present, else generates a deterministic editorial gradient from `event.id`.
67	
68	**E2.** Slots-tab `Action` column — replace lock-icon placeholder with explicit row-level dropdown `[⋯]` containing: `SMS reminder · Reschedule · Refund deposit · Mark walk-in · Mark no-show`. Each item disabled based on slot status (e.g., Mark walk-in only on `open`, Refund only when deposit paid).
69	
70	**E3.** Server-action sentinel sanitization — see B5.
71	
72	**E4.** Slots tab Draft state — keep current empty state copy, but add "Designs uploaded: N · Add more before publishing" hint linking to Designs tab.
73	
74	**E5.** Status pill styling — add `cancelled` to STATUS_CONFIG in [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:23-31](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L23-L31) (already present; verify) so Cancelled events render correctly inside `All` filter view.
75	
76	### F. ADDS
77	
78	**F1. Stat strip above grid** — 4 KPI cards on `/flash-events` listing page above the filter chips:
79	- `UPCOMING` count — events with `event_date >= today AND status IN ('draft','published')`
80	- `SLOTS FILLED · 30D` — `booked_slots / total_slots` for events in the next 30 days

262	-- 6. generate_flash_event_slots(event_id)
263	--    Inserts open slots from event start_time → end_time at slot_duration_min
264	--    intervals on event_date. Skips slots that already exist (idempotent).
265	--    Must be called as studio member (service-role in webhook/action).
266	-- ============================================================
267	
268	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_flash_event_slots(p_event_id uuid)
269	RETURNS int  -- returns number of slots generated
270	LANGUAGE plpgsql
271	SECURITY DEFINER
272	AS $$
273	DECLARE
274	  v_event         flash_events%ROWTYPE;
275	  v_slot_start    timestamptz;
276	  v_slot_end      timestamptz;
277	  v_event_tz      text;
278	  v_base_date     date;
279	  v_current       timestamptz;
280	  v_count         int := 0;
281	BEGIN
282	  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = p_event_id;
283	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
284	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_event not found: %', p_event_id;
285	  END IF;
286	
287	  -- Resolve studio timezone
288	  SELECT timezone INTO v_event_tz FROM studios WHERE id = v_event.studio_id;
289	  v_event_tz := COALESCE(v_event_tz, 'UTC');
290	
291	  v_base_date := v_event.event_date;
292	
293	  -- Build start timestamp in studio local time, then convert to UTC
294	  v_current := (v_base_date::text || ' ' || v_event.start_time::text)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE v_event_tz;
295	
296	  LOOP
297	    v_slot_start := v_current;
298	    v_slot_end   := v_current + (v_event.slot_duration_min || ' minutes')::interval;
299	
300	    -- Stop if slot_end exceeds end_time
301	    EXIT WHEN v_slot_end > (v_base_date::text || ' ' || v_event.end_time::text)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE v_event_tz;
302	
303	    -- Respect max_slots
304	    EXIT WHEN v_event.max_slots IS NOT NULL AND v_count >= v_event.max_slots;
305	
306	    INSERT INTO flash_event_slots (flash_event_id, slot_start, slot_end, status)
307	    VALUES (p_event_id, v_slot_start, v_slot_end, 'open')
308	    ON CONFLICT (flash_event_id, slot_start) DO NOTHING;
309	
310	    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
311	    v_count := v_count + 1;  -- approximate; ON CONFLICT may not insert
312	
313	    v_current := v_slot_end;
314	  END LOOP;
315	
316	  -- Re-count actual slots
317	  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM flash_event_slots WHERE flash_event_id = p_event_id AND status = 'open';
318	  RETURN v_count;
319	END;
320	$$;
321	
322	-- ============================================================
323	-- 7. public_reserve_flash_slot(studio_slug, event_slug, slot_id, client_info)
324	--    SECURITY DEFINER — called by anon public booking page.
325	--    Atomically claims a slot (open → reserved) and creates a pending booking row.
326	--    Returns: { booking_token, slot_id, error? }
327	-- ============================================================
328	
329	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public_reserve_flash_slot(
330	  p_studio_slug  text,
331	  p_event_slug   text,
332	  p_slot_id      uuid,
333	  p_client_info  jsonb  -- { first_name, last_name?, email, phone?, notes? }
334	)
335	RETURNS jsonb
336	LANGUAGE plpgsql
337	SECURITY DEFINER
338	AS $$
339	DECLARE
340	  v_studio       studios%ROWTYPE;
341	  v_event        flash_events%ROWTYPE;
342	  v_slot         flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
343	  v_client_id    uuid;
344	  v_booking_id   uuid;
345	  v_booking_token text;
346	  v_artist_id    uuid;
347	BEGIN
348	  -- Resolve studio
349	  SELECT * INTO v_studio FROM studios WHERE slug = p_studio_slug AND status = 'active';
350	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
351	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'studio_not_found');
352	  END IF;
353	
354	  -- Resolve event (must be public+published)
355	  SELECT * INTO v_event
356	  FROM flash_events
357	  WHERE studio_id = v_studio.id
358	    AND slug = p_event_slug
359	    AND public = true
360	    AND status = 'published';
361	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
362	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'event_not_found');
363	  END IF;
364	
365	  -- Lock and claim slot atomically
366	  SELECT * INTO v_slot
367	  FROM flash_event_slots
368	  WHERE id = p_slot_id
369	    AND flash_event_id = v_event.id
370	    AND status = 'open'
371	  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
372	
373	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
374	    -- Either slot gone or already locked by concurrent request
375	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'slot_unavailable');
376	  END IF;
377	
378	  -- Expire stale reservations opportunistically
379	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
380	  SET status = 'open', booking_id = NULL, reserved_until = NULL
381	  WHERE flash_event_id = v_event.id
382	    AND status = 'reserved'
383	    AND reserved_until < now();
384	
385	  -- Upsert client by email within this studio
386	  INSERT INTO clients (studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, source, created_at, updated_at)
387	  VALUES (
388	    v_studio.id,
389	    p_client_info->>'first_name',
390	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'last_name', ''),
391	    LOWER(TRIM(p_client_info->>'email')),
392	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'phone', ''),
393	    'public',
394	    now(),
395	    now()
396	  )
397	  ON CONFLICT (studio_id, email) DO UPDATE
398	    SET updated_at = now()
399	  RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;
400	
401	  -- Resolve artist (use event artist if set, else use a placeholder approach)
402	  v_artist_id := v_event.artist_id;
403	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
404	    -- Pick the first active artist for this studio as a fallback
405	    SELECT id INTO v_artist_id FROM artists
406	    WHERE studio_id = v_studio.id AND status = 'active'
407	    ORDER BY sort_order LIMIT 1;
408	  END IF;
409	
410	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
411	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'no_artist_available');
412	  END IF;
413	
414	  -- Generate booking token
415	  v_booking_token := gen_random_uuid()::text;
416	  v_booking_id    := gen_random_uuid();
417	
418	  -- Create pending booking
419	  INSERT INTO bookings (
420	    id, studio_id, client_id, artist_id,
421	    scheduled_at, duration_min,
422	    status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid,
423	    booking_token, source,
424	    notes, client_notes,
425	    location_id, metadata,
426	    consent_required,
427	    created_at, updated_at
428	  ) VALUES (
429	    v_booking_id,
430	    v_studio.id,
431	    v_client_id,
432	    v_artist_id,
433	    v_slot.slot_start,
434	    v_event.slot_duration_min,
435	    'pending',
436	    v_event.slot_price_cents,
437	    v_event.deposit_cents,
438	    false,
439	    v_booking_token,
440	    'public',
441	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'notes', ''),
442	    NULL,
443	    v_event.location_id,
444	    jsonb_build_object('flash_event_id', v_event.id, 'flash_event_slug', v_event.slug),
445	    false,
446	    now(),
447	    now()
448	  );
449	
450	  -- Reserve the slot (15-minute hold)
451	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
452	  SET status         = 'reserved',
453	      booking_id     = v_booking_id,
454	      reserved_until = now() + interval '15 minutes'
455	  WHERE id = v_slot.id;
456	
457	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
458	    'booking_token', v_booking_token,
459	    'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
460	    'slot_id',       v_slot.id
461	  );
462	END;
463	$$;
464	
465	-- ============================================================
466	-- 8. confirm_flash_slot_booking(booking_id)
467	--    Called by webhook after deposit paid. Transitions slot reserved → booked.
468	-- ============================================================
469	
470	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION confirm_flash_slot_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
471	RETURNS boolean
472	LANGUAGE plpgsql
473	SECURITY DEFINER
474	AS $$
475	BEGIN
476	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
477	  SET status = 'booked', reserved_until = NULL
478	  WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
479	    AND status IN ('open', 'reserved');
480	
481	  RETURN FOUND;
482	END;
483	$$;
484	
485	-- ============================================================
486	-- 9. Storage bucket (SQL-side note)
487	--    Execute in Supabase dashboard or via storage API:
488	--      supabase.storage.createBucket('flash-event-assets', { public: false })
489	--    Policies: studio members can upload; public can read when event is published.
490	--    Manual step documented here; bucket creation via SQL is not standard in Supabase CLI.
491	-- ============================================================
492	
493	COMMENT ON TABLE flash_events IS 'Flash day events — one-off booking events with pre-set time slots';
494	COMMENT ON TABLE flash_event_designs IS 'Flash sheet designs available at a flash event';
495	COMMENT ON TABLE flash_event_slots IS 'Auto-generated time slots for a flash event';

-- ============================================================
-- Migration : 20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1
-- Purpose   : Flash Events day-of-operations audit — walk-in, no-show,
--             check-in, duplicate, close-out RPCs + schema hardening
-- Depends on: 20260422100000_flash_events.sql
-- Rollback  :
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS close_flash_event(uuid);
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS duplicate_flash_event(uuid);
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS mark_flash_slot_checked_in(uuid);
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS mark_flash_slot_no_show(uuid);
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS mark_flash_slot_walkin(uuid, jsonb, boolean);
--   DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_flash_event_slots_grace;
--   ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots
--     DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking,
--     DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS flash_event_slots_status_check_v2,
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS walk_in,
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS checked_in_at,
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS grace_expires_at,
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS no_show_marked_at;
--   ALTER TABLE flash_events
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tips_collected_cents,
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS completed_at;
-- ============================================================


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 1 — Extend flash_events columns
-- ============================================================

-- completed_at: set when the event is closed via close_flash_event()
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE flash_events ADD COLUMN completed_at timestamptz NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL;
END $$;

-- tips_collected_cents: cash/card tips collected at the event desk
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE flash_events ADD COLUMN tips_collected_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL;
END $$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 2 — Extend flash_event_slots columns
-- ============================================================

-- no_show_marked_at: timestamp when the slot was marked no-show
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots ADD COLUMN no_show_marked_at timestamptz NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL;
END $$;

-- grace_expires_at: slot_start + 15min — client must check in by this time
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots ADD COLUMN grace_expires_at timestamptz NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL;
END $$;

-- checked_in_at: timestamp when front-desk confirmed client arrived
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots ADD COLUMN checked_in_at timestamptz NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL;
END $$;

-- walk_in: true when the booking was created at the desk (no online reservation)
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots ADD COLUMN walk_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL;
END $$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 3 — Replace status CHECK constraint to include 'no_show'
-- ============================================================

-- Drop the original unnamed check (PostgreSQL auto-names it flash_event_slots_status_check)
ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS flash_event_slots_status_check;

-- Drop a previously named version in case this migration was partially applied
ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS flash_event_slots_status_check_v2;

-- Add new named constraint with 'no_show' included
ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots
  ADD CONSTRAINT flash_event_slots_status_check_v2
  CHECK (status IN ('open', 'reserved', 'booked', 'blocked', 'no_show'));


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 4 — Backfill before adding NOT NULL constraint
--
-- Any 'booked' slot with NULL booking_id is orphaned data from
-- the seed or dev testing. Reset those to 'open' so the
-- integrity constraint passes cleanly.
-- ============================================================

UPDATE flash_event_slots
SET status = 'open'
WHERE status = 'booked'
  AND booking_id IS NULL;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 5 — Add booking integrity constraint
--
-- A slot that carries status='booked' MUST reference a booking row.
-- Walk-ins create the booking row first, so this is always satisfiable.
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking;

ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots
  ADD CONSTRAINT chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking
  CHECK (status <> 'booked' OR booking_id IS NOT NULL);


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 6 — Grace-period index
--
-- Cron / background job sweeps booked slots where grace has expired
-- and client has not checked in — this index makes that O(log n).
-- ============================================================

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_flash_event_slots_grace
  ON flash_event_slots(grace_expires_at)
  WHERE status = 'booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 7 — Helper: studio membership guard
--
-- Inline function used by staff-facing SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
-- Raises 'forbidden' if the calling user is not an active member
-- of the studio that owns the given flash event slot or event.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot(p_slot_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT fe.studio_id INTO v_studio_id
  FROM flash_event_slots fes
  INNER JOIN flash_events fe ON fe.id = fes.flash_event_id
  WHERE fes.id = p_slot_id;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
    WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _flash_assert_studio_member_for_event(p_event_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT studio_id INTO v_studio_id
  FROM flash_events
  WHERE id = p_event_id;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
    WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 8 — RPC: mark_flash_slot_walkin
--
-- Called from a server action using the service-role client
-- (no auth.uid() available), so no membership check here.
-- Creates a client upsert, a bookings row, then transitions
-- the slot directly open → booked (skipping reserved).
-- Returns: { booking_id, booking_token, slot_id } or { error }
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_walkin(
  p_slot_id        uuid,
  p_client_info    jsonb,    -- { first_name, last_name?, email, phone?, notes? }
  p_charge_at_desk boolean   -- hint for the caller; stored in booking metadata
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_slot          flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
  v_event         flash_events%ROWTYPE;
  v_client_id     uuid;
  v_booking_id    uuid;
  v_booking_token text;
  v_artist_id     uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Lock the slot atomically; skip if already locked by concurrent request
  SELECT * INTO v_slot
  FROM flash_event_slots
  WHERE id = p_slot_id
    AND status = 'open'
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'slot_unavailable');
  END IF;

  -- Resolve parent event
  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = v_slot.flash_event_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'event_not_found');
  END IF;

  -- Upsert client by email scoped to this studio (mirrors public_reserve_flash_slot)
  INSERT INTO clients (studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, source, created_at, updated_at)
  VALUES (
    v_event.studio_id,
    p_client_info->>'first_name',
    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'last_name', ''),
    LOWER(TRIM(p_client_info->>'email')),
    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'phone', ''),
    'walk-in',
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (studio_id, email) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;

  -- Resolve artist (event artist → first active studio artist)
  v_artist_id := v_event.artist_id;
  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_artist_id
    FROM artists
    WHERE studio_id = v_event.studio_id AND status = 'active'
    ORDER BY sort_order
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'no_artist_available');
  END IF;

  -- Generate IDs
  v_booking_token := gen_random_uuid()::text;
  v_booking_id    := gen_random_uuid();

  -- Create booking row (status=pending; payment collected at desk separately)
  INSERT INTO bookings (
    id, studio_id, client_id, artist_id,
    scheduled_at, duration_min,
    status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid,
    booking_token, source,
    notes, client_notes,
    location_id, metadata,
    consent_required,
    created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_booking_id,
    v_event.studio_id,
    v_client_id,
    v_artist_id,
    v_slot.slot_start,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v_slot.slot_end - v_slot.slot_start)) / 60)::int,
    'pending',
    v_event.slot_price_cents,
    0,         -- walk-ins pay at desk; no online deposit
    false,
    v_booking_token,
    'walk-in',
    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'notes', ''),
    NULL,
    v_event.location_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'flash_event_id',   v_event.id,
      'flash_event_slug', v_event.slug,
      'walk_in',          true,
      'charge_at_desk',   p_charge_at_desk
    ),
    false,
    now(),
    now()
  );

  -- Transition slot directly to booked (walk-in skips reserved state)
  UPDATE flash_event_slots
  SET status         = 'booked',
      booking_id     = v_booking_id,
      walk_in        = true,
      reserved_until = NULL,
      -- grace window starts from slot_start, not now()
      grace_expires_at = v_slot.slot_start + interval '15 minutes'
  WHERE id = v_slot.id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
    'booking_token', v_booking_token,
    'slot_id',       v_slot.id
  );
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 9 — RPC: mark_flash_slot_no_show
--
-- Staff-facing. Validates slot is 'booked' and not yet checked in.
-- Sets status='no_show', mirrors to the linked booking row.
-- Returns true if transition occurred.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_slot flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- Membership guard: caller must be an active studio member
  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot(p_slot_id);

  -- Lock and validate slot state
  SELECT * INTO v_slot
  FROM flash_event_slots
  WHERE id = p_slot_id
    AND status = 'booked'
    AND checked_in_at IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN false;  -- Already no-show, not booked, or already checked in
  END IF;

  -- Transition slot
  UPDATE flash_event_slots
  SET status            = 'no_show',
      no_show_marked_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_slot_id;

  -- Mirror status to booking row so booking list reflects reality
  UPDATE bookings
  SET status     = 'no_show',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = v_slot.booking_id;

  RETURN true;
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 10 — RPC: mark_flash_slot_checked_in
--
-- Staff-facing. Validates slot is 'booked'. Sets checked_in_at=now().
-- Idempotent: calling a second time is a no-op (returns true).
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Membership guard
  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot(p_slot_id);

  -- Only act if slot is booked (any checked_in_at state — idempotent)
  UPDATE flash_event_slots
  SET checked_in_at = COALESCE(checked_in_at, now())
  WHERE id = p_slot_id
    AND status = 'booked';

  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 11 — RPC: duplicate_flash_event
--
-- Staff-facing. Deep-copies event + designs; skips slots.
-- New event: status='draft', event_date = today + 14 days,
-- slug appended with '-copy-<epoch>'.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION duplicate_flash_event(p_event_id uuid)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_src    flash_events%ROWTYPE;
  v_new_id uuid;
  v_new_slug text;
BEGIN
  -- Membership guard
  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_event(p_event_id);

  SELECT * INTO v_src FROM flash_events WHERE id = p_event_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_event not found: %', p_event_id;
  END IF;

  v_new_id   := gen_random_uuid();
  v_new_slug := v_src.slug || '-copy-' || EXTRACT(epoch FROM now())::bigint;

  -- Insert new event, resetting lifecycle columns
  INSERT INTO flash_events (
    id, studio_id, artist_id,
    title, slug, description,
    event_date, start_time, end_time,
    slot_duration_min, slot_price_cents, deposit_cents,
    currency, max_slots,
    cover_image_url, flyer_url, location_id,
    public, status,
    published_at, cancelled_at, completed_at,
    tips_collected_cents,
    created_by, created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_new_id,
    v_src.studio_id,
    v_src.artist_id,
    v_src.title || ' (Copy)',
    v_new_slug,
    v_src.description,
    CURRENT_DATE + 14,
    v_src.start_time,
    v_src.end_time,
    v_src.slot_duration_min,
    v_src.slot_price_cents,
    v_src.deposit_cents,
    v_src.currency,
    v_src.max_slots,
    v_src.cover_image_url,
    v_src.flyer_url,
    v_src.location_id,
    v_src.public,
    'draft',         -- always starts as draft
    NULL,            -- published_at reset
    NULL,            -- cancelled_at reset
    NULL,            -- completed_at reset
    0,               -- tips reset
    auth.uid(),
    now(),
    now()
  );

  -- Deep-copy designs (not slots — slots are regenerated via generate_flash_event_slots)
  INSERT INTO flash_event_designs (
    id, flash_event_id,
    title, image_url, size_description,
    placement_options, price_cents,
    display_order, sold_out, created_at
  )
  SELECT
    gen_random_uuid(),
    v_new_id,
    title, image_url, size_description,
    placement_options, price_cents,
    display_order, false, now()
  FROM flash_event_designs
  WHERE flash_event_id = p_event_id;

  RETURN v_new_id;
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 12 — RPC: close_flash_event
--
-- Staff-facing. Marks event completed=now(), returns a summary
-- jsonb for the UI close-out modal.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION close_flash_event(p_event_id uuid)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_event          flash_events%ROWTYPE;
  v_completed_cnt  int;
  v_no_show_cnt    int;
  v_slot_rev       bigint;
  v_deposit_rev    bigint;
  v_top_design_id  uuid;
  v_top_design_ttl text;
  v_top_design_cnt int;
BEGIN
  -- Membership guard
  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_event(p_event_id);

  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = p_event_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_event not found: %', p_event_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_event.status <> 'published' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event must be published to close; current status: %', v_event.status;
  END IF;

  -- Transition event to completed
  UPDATE flash_events
  SET status       = 'completed',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at   = now()
  WHERE id = p_event_id;

  -- Aggregate slot stats
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked'),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'no_show')
  INTO v_completed_cnt, v_no_show_cnt
  FROM flash_event_slots
  WHERE flash_event_id = p_event_id;

  -- Revenue: sum slot_price_cents for booked slots via their booking rows
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.price_cents), 0)
  INTO v_slot_rev
  FROM flash_event_slots fes
  INNER JOIN bookings b ON b.id = fes.booking_id
  WHERE fes.flash_event_id = p_event_id
    AND fes.status = 'booked';

  -- Deposits: sum deposit_cents for booked+deposit_paid bookings
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.deposit_cents), 0)
  INTO v_deposit_rev
  FROM flash_event_slots fes
  INNER JOIN bookings b ON b.id = fes.booking_id
  WHERE fes.flash_event_id = p_event_id
    AND fes.status = 'booked'
    AND b.deposit_paid = true;

  -- Top design by booking count
  SELECT
    fes.design_id,
    fed.title,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  INTO v_top_design_id, v_top_design_ttl, v_top_design_cnt
  FROM flash_event_slots fes
  INNER JOIN flash_event_designs fed ON fed.id = fes.design_id
  WHERE fes.flash_event_id = p_event_id
    AND fes.status = 'booked'
    AND fes.design_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fes.design_id, fed.title
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'event_id',                p_event_id,
    'completed_count',         v_completed_cnt,
    'no_show_count',           v_no_show_cnt,
    'slot_revenue_cents',      v_slot_rev,
    'deposits_collected_cents', v_deposit_rev,
    'tips_cents',              v_event.tips_collected_cents,
    'top_design',              CASE
                                 WHEN v_top_design_id IS NOT NULL THEN
                                   jsonb_build_object(
                                     'id',    v_top_design_id,
                                     'title', v_top_design_ttl,
                                     'count', v_top_design_cnt
                                   )
                                 ELSE NULL
                               END,
    'artist_id',               v_event.artist_id
  );
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 13 — UPDATE existing confirm_flash_slot_booking
--
-- Adds grace_expires_at = slot_start + 15 minutes when
-- transitioning a slot to booked. Existing callers (deposit webhook)
-- are unaffected — same signature, richer side-effect.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION confirm_flash_slot_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE flash_event_slots
  SET status           = 'booked',
      reserved_until   = NULL,
      -- grace window: 15 minutes from scheduled slot start
      grace_expires_at = slot_start + interval '15 minutes'
  WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
    AND status IN ('open', 'reserved');

  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 14 — Table comments
-- ============================================================

COMMENT ON COLUMN flash_events.completed_at        IS 'Set by close_flash_event() when the event day is closed out';
COMMENT ON COLUMN flash_events.tips_collected_cents IS 'Cash/card tips collected at the event desk, recorded at close-out';

COMMENT ON COLUMN flash_event_slots.no_show_marked_at IS 'Timestamp when mark_flash_slot_no_show() was called';
COMMENT ON COLUMN flash_event_slots.grace_expires_at  IS 'slot_start + 15 min; cron marks no-show after this if checked_in_at is NULL';
COMMENT ON COLUMN flash_event_slots.checked_in_at     IS 'Timestamp when front-desk confirmed client arrived';
COMMENT ON COLUMN flash_event_slots.walk_in           IS 'True when booking was created at the desk (mark_flash_slot_walkin)';
